purpose: Teach: プロテスタント/永住/聖人/女系/震度/上半身/巨匠/社団

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、プロテスタント圏向け商品を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our product line in Protestant-majority markets.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Measured pace. No room for negotiation. The tone of someone used to being heard and obeyed without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。永住権を持つ社員のサポートを整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we have proper support systems in place for our permanent resident staff.
lines.style: Respectful but focused. Efficient delivery—no flourish. Slight nod in the voice. Demonstrating competence through clean execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員を聖人扱いせず公平に評価しろ
lines.en: Evaluate all staff fairly. No special treatment based on family ties.
lines.style: Direct and firm. Weight on the fairness principle. Each phrase lands. No softening—this is a correction dressed as an order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業家の女系継承も検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also explore succession planning through the female line of the founding family.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Steady pace. Shows he's already thinking three moves ahead. Slight pause before the second clause—demonstrating he's incorporated the previous note.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、震度別の事業継続計画を整えろ
lines.en: We need disaster response protocols by seismic grade. Have it ready.
lines.style: Urgent without raising volume. Slight acceleration on 'disaster.' The underlying tension of a man thinking through worst-case scenarios. Expectant ending.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の上半身ストレッチ研修も追加します
lines.en: Yes. I'll add occupational wellness training for upper-body stress relief to the curriculum.
lines.style: Methodical, efficient. Shows he's listening to the implicit concern. Warm undertone—not just compliance but care. Delivery suggests he's already writing the memo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界巨匠の助言を活かせ
lines.en: Tap into the wisdom of industry veterans. Use it.
lines.style: Sharp, economical. Emphasis on 'use'—not just hear, but act. The voice of someone who values practical wisdom over theory. Commanding but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社団法人と提携を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll pursue a strategic partnership with the industry association.
lines.style: Closing note of finality. Calm, assured. Demonstrates he's integrated all previous instructions into a coherent plan. Slight lift at the end—ready to execute.
